verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single docs line saying that when invoice payment fails, Stripe can automatically retry the payment or send reminders. This covers basic automatic retries. Nothing in the pack shows that the retry cadence is ML-driven or schedule-optimized, or that recovery is measured. Missing for 10: ML/smart or configurable optimized retry scheduling, recovery-rate or involuntary-churn metrics, and independent corroboration of recovery outcomes.
